steps.why: The app installs its data to /sdcard/UrTQuest. The guide has the user allow file access on the first start.

steps.text: Open Urban Terror VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. Press I agree - download and install, and wait for the 1.4 GB download. Then change your player name in the player setup.

notes: The app downloads the free Urban Terror 4.3.4 data to /sdcard/UrTQuest/q3ut4 on the first start; about 3 GB is needed while it installs. Existing Urban Terror 4.3 data copied to that folder is reused; qgp does not offer that. The guide says "allow file access" without naming the permission; All files access is assumed. The asset pattern does not match the .apk.sha256 file.
